newsitem.title: USA: Trinova in talks to sell more plastics units.
newsitem.headline: Trinova in talks to sell more plastics units.

text.p: Trinova Corp said Wednesday it is "in various stages of negotiation" to sell its remaining automotive interior plastics facilities.
Trinova, which took a $30 million charge in the first quarter for selling three interior plastics facilities in March, said it is exiting this line of business.

"The market for interior plastics has changed over the last few years, and today customers prefer to work with large, integrated suppliers, rather than component manufacturers," Chairman Darryl Allen said in a statement.
The company said its remaining interior plastics facilities had 1996 sales of about $100 million.
